export OMAR_CODEX_SOCKET='<DIR>/codex-runtime/<HEX12>/app.sock'; codex app-server --listen 'unix://<DIR>/codex-runtime/<HEX12>/app.sock' -c features.scheduled_tasks=false -c 'mcp_servers.omar.command="<EXE>"' -c 'mcp_servers.omar.args=["mcp-server","--context-file","<DIR>/mcp/ea-0/context.json"]' -c "developer_instructions=$(cat '<DIR>/codex-runtime/<HEX12>/instructions.json')" >'<DIR>/codex-runtime/<HEX12>/server.log' 2>&1 & omar_srv=$!; omar_waited=0; while [ ! -S "$OMAR_CODEX_SOCKET" ] && [ "$omar_waited" -lt 100 ] && kill -0 "$omar_srv" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.2; omar_waited=$((omar_waited+1)); done; if [ ! -S "$OMAR_CODEX_SOCKET" ]; then cat '<DIR>/codex-runtime/<HEX12>/server.log' >&2; kill "$omar_srv" 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; codex --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --remote 'unix://<DIR>/codex-runtime/<HEX12>/app.sock'
